title: Frank names Khalaili and McNeil in Palace starting XI
text:
Frank names Khalaili and McNeil in Palace starting XI Tu Futbolero en Log in Sign up Back to the board Squads 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 Premier 46m ago · November 21, 2026 Frank names Khalaili and McNeil in Palace starting XI
 Palace visit Coventry City this Saturday at 15:00 GMT without Mateta, suspended after his red card at Tottenham, with Henderson as captain.
 By TuFutbolero Newsroom · November 21, 2026 at 07:40 AM 
 Next match Crystal Palace Real Sociedad Thursday 26 November · 12:00 Line-ups, result and where to watch → Thomas Frank has announced the starting XI for Crystal Palace in their trip to Coventry City, a Premier League match played this Saturday, 21 November, at 15:00 GMT at the CBS Arena. According to the club's official website, the manager keeps nine players from the defeat to Liverpool before the international break.

 The changes are Anan Khalaili and Dwight McNeil . Khalaili starts a league match for the first time since the game against Newcastle last month. Dean Henderson will captain the side, while Jørgen Strand Larsen leads the attack. Jean-Philippe Mateta misses the game after his red card at Tottenham.
 On the bench, Jefferson Lerma is among the substitutes and Evann Guessand returns to the matchday squad, with Dario Osorio and Eddie Nketiah as options to add attacking firepower.
